sections.Description:
Players will be transported to 1313 Mockingbird Lane, joining the entire Munsters family on this haunted pinball adventure.

Featuring Herman, Raven, Lily, Spot and Grandpa, players will work their way towards Munster Madness in this frightfully funny and action-packed pinball world under glass.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Grandpa’s Labratory: Explore Grandpa’s Labratory in the lower playfield, featuring mini flippers, ramps, a bash target, a digital number display and 2 mini pinballs.
- Bash Herman: Watch as the custom sculpted Herman bash toy grabs the ball with a magnetized ball catch as you attempt to start Herman Multiball.
- Pop-up Spot: Watch out as the Left Ramp will pop-up revealing the hidden custom sculpted Spot bash toy under the Ramp.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- Featuring striking original hand-drawn art by artist Christopher Franchi.
- Main shot insert RGB LED lighting and General Illumination green and white LED lighting.
- Multifunction RGB ‘ZAP!’ button located on the lockdownbar.

Premium:
- Music laugh track and speech from classic The Munsters episodes augmented with original customer speech and music.
- Featuring an exclusive black and white high definition art package including the entire playfield.
- Featuring an exclusive black and white high definition art package including the backglass and full cabinet art.

Limited Edition:
- High definitely speaker system with 3-channel amplifier featuring Music laugh track and speech from classic The Munsters episodes.
- Black wrinkle laser cut spider web armor with gold insert and gold metallic legs.
- Limited edition exclusive art blades hand drawn by Christopher Franchi.
